result.summary: The layout is largely intact, but there is a clearly broken favorite (heart) button on the second 'Popular right now' card, plus an inconsistency between the active 'Pizza' filter and the listings shown, and a mismatched thumbnail treatment in the 'Fastest near you' carousel.

issues.description: The favorite/heart button on the second 'Popular right now' card (the pizza card) uses a dark/near-black circular background with a dark outlined heart, making it nearly invisible against the dark food image. The equivalent button on the Tokumaru Ramen Bar card above uses a white circle with a dark heart, so the two are visually inconsistent and the second one fails contrast.
issues.suggestion: Apply the same white (or semi-transparent light) circular background and dark heart icon to every favorite button so the control is always legible over imagery.

issues.description: The 'Pizza' category chip is shown as selected (dark/active), yet the results below include poké, burgers, pasta and ramen restaurants, implying the filter is not being applied to the listings.
issues.suggestion: Either apply the selected category filter to the restaurant sections, or reset the chip to 'All' when unfiltered content is displayed.

issues.description: In the 'Fastest near you' carousel, the first thumbnail (Green Bowl Poké) has a light gray background while the neighbouring cards use dark photographic backgrounds, creating an inconsistent visual rhythm; the white '15–25 min' badge also has weak contrast on that light tile.
issues.suggestion: Normalise thumbnail backgrounds/treatments across carousel items and add a subtle scrim or darker badge background so the duration badge stays readable on light images.
